fixed.explanation: test.describe.configure() is implemented in TestTypeImpl._configure, which only handles mode, retries and timeout. Suites already have a _locks array that _describe fills from details, so I added a lock option there that appends to the current suite's _locks. Nested groups and tests inherit it the same way they inherit describe-details locks.
